strategyPoints: Tire degradation will be a major factor today on this abrasive Laguna Seca surface, especially with the heat.
The pit window is relatively short here, meaning teams will need to execute their stops perfectly.
Fuel consumption will be a concern, particularly for those pushing hard in the early stages.
With only 11 turns, getting a clean run is key, as every tenth counts on this 3.602km layout.
Overcut or undercut? The placement of the pit exit relative to Turn 1 will be a key factor in strategic decisions.
Managing the front tires through the Corkscrew and Rainey Curve will be crucial for a strong finish.
Track position is vital here, as overtaking can be difficult, so a good qualifying performance is essential.
Look for teams to experiment with different downforce levels to find the optimal balance between speed and tire conservation.

We're expecting clear skies and sunshine throughout the race, providing ideal conditions for racing.
